method: Blind independent re-key by agent #147, 2026-09-04: every PDF page rendered at 200 dpi (pdftoppm) and read as an image; rows typed from the images into a scratch transcript before any text layer or accepted file was consulted; then self-checked (Euler, b-ratio on the 1/2+3k/1000 sweep grid, per-page/per-block counts) and cross-checked against a fresh pdftotext -layout parse of the same pages. The accepted harness/schmitt_hexagonal_tables.json was NOT opened before this file was complete.
coordinate_note: Generating points are printed in Schmitt's transformed orthogonal basis B'' (Sec. 2.2.3 preamble), copied verbatim.
